create_adan_optimizer: create an Adan optimizer instance with custom learning rate and beta parameters for deep model training
step_adan_optimizer: perform a single optimization step using the Adan optimizer to update model parameters
restart_adan_optimizer: restart the Adan optimizer by resetting step counter and zeroing all exponential moving average states
configure_adan_weight_decay: configure the Adan optimizer with decoupled weight decay and optional prox or no_prox mode
review_adan_single_tensor: review the single tensor Adan update function that computes gradient EMA, squared EMA, and difference EMA
